title: ENT specialists find otolith damage in Havana syndrome

plain: Chris Gilbert, a researcher speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, talks about Havana syndrome, a set of unexplained health complaints reported by US government staff. He says that ear, nose and throat doctors found that the otolith, a tiny balance organ inside the inner ear, was affected consistently in most of the cases. If true, it would point to a real physical injury behind the reports.
